visualCharacteristics: Grid of account cards on a light background, each with a top accent bar, an account name heading, a short description, and one or two CTA links. No images.
contentPattern: One row per card, single column: heading (account name), label/description paragraph(s), CTA link(s).
usage: Present a set of account types as cards with a name, description, and open/learn CTAs. Typically rendered inside tabbed panels.
